value.rationale: The paper uses the printed scheme to support its numerical verification, and the sign error changes the stochastic Taylor term that distinguishes Milstein from Euler–Maruyama. The exact test shows a full loss of strong convergence order, from one to one-half, so the issue is mathematically substantive for reproducibility and step-size accuracy rather than a typographical normalization check.
